# Provenance: lunar frame campaign datum by the square-root information solver, 50-digit mpmath oracle

- `inputs.json`: Kshana's own committed inputs, written on 2026-10-02 after the pre-registration
  commit `b41908c9` by
  `KSHANA_WRITE_MPMATH_FIXTURE=1 cargo test --test lunar_frame_campaign_srif_mpmath_oracle engine_inputs_match_the_committed_fixture -- --ignored`
  (the test was still ignored then): the delay Jacobian, weights, station-column count and
  Helmert design of four scenarios. The solver does not change the inputs. The 2026-03-18 and
  2024-01-01 Jacobians are bit-identical to those of `../lunar_frame_campaign_mpmath_oracle`.
  SHA-256 `f97b616c86001333bb354263d3303de4c249ffa9aafc91f3d82c50b1faa7fc74`.
- `reference.json`: the output of `gen_reference.py`, run once on 2026-10-02. SHA-256
  `381fbe4bcab044a80b6f74d31ae93fb692446f05dcd23982ed3da9a02623c7d4` (`gen_reference.py`
  `44c502481277909701342fff2f89be8cb8b5d65ad8662eb608cdf850add7bda0`). The script imports its matrix helpers
  unchanged from `../lunar_frame_campaign_mpmath_oracle/gen_reference.py`.
- **Tools:** mpmath 1.3.0 (BSD-3-Clause) at 50 digits, checked at 80; Python 3.11.15; run as a
  separate program from `$ORACLE_PY` of `~/Code/kshana-oracles/env.sh`; nothing is linked into
  kshana.
- **Licence of the committed files:** generated by this project (AGPL-3.0-only); no third-party
  data.
- **Reproduce:** `source ~/Code/kshana-oracles/env.sh; $ORACLE_PY gen_reference.py inputs.json > reference.json`.
- **Consumed by:** `tests/lunar_frame_campaign_srif_mpmath_oracle.rs`.
